#Question 3
x_value=cars$speed
x<-matrix(x_value,nrow=50,ncol=1)  #finding vector x
x
y_value=cars$dist
y<-matrix(y_value,nrow=50,ncol=1) #finding vector y
y
M <- matrix(1,nrow=50,ncol=1)
Mx <- cbind(M,x)                 #creating matrix X to find transporse of x
e<- solve(t(Mx)%*%Mx)%*%(t(Mx)%*%y) #finding B estimates
e

#Question5
beta0=-17.5791
beta1=3.9324
n <- length(x)
y_pred <- beta0 + beta1 * x
residuals <- y - y_pred
se_beta0 <- sqrt(sum(residuals^2) / (n - 2))

se_beta1 <- se_beta0 / sqrt(sum((x - mean(x))^2))
se_beta1
tvalue_beta0<- (beta0/se_beta0)
tvalue_beta1<- (beta1/se_beta1)
